name: FastMCP Server Template
description: A production-ready MCP server template that enables developers to quickly build and deploy MCP servers with dynamic tool/resource loading, YAML-based prompts, and seamless OpenShift deployment. Supports both local development with hot-reload and production HTTP deployment with optional JWT authentication.

MCP_HTTP_HOST.description: HTTP server host for HTTP transport

MCP_HTTP_PATH.description: HTTP endpoint path for HTTP transport

MCP_HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP server port for HTTP transport

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport protocol to use (stdio for local development, http for OpenShift deployment)

MCP_AUTH_JWT_SECRET.description: JWT secret for symmetric signing (optional authentication)

MCP_AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY.description: JWT public key for asymmetric signing (optional authentication)
